name: hybrids3
description: Self-hosted lightweight object storage speaking S3 (boto3/AWS SDK, Sig V4), plain HTTP (curl + Bearer auth), and MCP (Streamable HTTP tools) from one container — SQLite metadata, flat-file storage, config-defined buckets, per-bucket keys, a cross-bucket master key, and presigned GET/PUT URLs.

hybrids3_url.title: HybridS3 URL
hybrids3_url.description: Base URL of your running hybrids3 server (HYBRIDS3_URL), e.g. http://localhost:8080

hybrids3_key.title: HybridS3 bucket/master key
hybrids3_key.description: Bearer token (HYBRIDS3_KEY) — a bucket's private key or the master key. Only needed if the endpoint requires connection-level auth.
